answer: Filecoin proved storage cannot be faked: each ballot seals its own 32 GiB sector through eleven sequential hash layers, then faces a gale of fourteen spot-checks, one per line of the sonnet, inside ten minutes. A farm cramming 10,000 ballots onto one disk holds one sector, so 9,986 answer with the wrong leaves and die, each forfeiting a $25 bond, $249,650 burned. The pool's pulse is WindowPoSt: ballots re-prove their sectors, and a missed 30-minute deadline slashes its stake. Like a library where every book is chained to its shelf, one copied sector kills 9,986 ballots and $249,650.
